frozen_outcomes_summary.epistemic_note: Identical-serialization score equality on the 21/24 equal-canonical pairs is by construction and is NOT empirical novelty.

cost_accounting.single_arm_deployment_overhead_note: In real single-arm deployment (one generated call per user request), canonical replay requires 1 extra unmasked teacher-forced forward pass (~1x prefill+call forward pass, ~92.4 ms on RTX 5060 for 1.5B) whenever the emitted surface serialization differs from canonical JSON (or unconditionally to guarantee grammar-invariant scoring). Within-prompt deduplication (21/24 pairs saved) applies to paired offline evaluation or multi-sample deduplication, NOT to single-sample production calls.

cluster_bootstrap_lofo_canon_vs_raw_post.caveat: Small exploratory sample (N=24 across 18 tool-family clusters; only 1 error in W and 2 errors in C). Bootstrap intervals reflect wide finite-sample uncertainty and discrete 1/24 (4.17 pp) granularity; NO selective-risk bootstrap claims are made.

prespecified_decision_gate.criterion: Canon Ye26 SMT-mean beats strongest raw post-mask baseline (`raw_post_gnll_smt_mean`) on free-generation coverage transfer by >= 8 pp smaller worst-direction |cov - 0.80| WITHOUT worse mean |cov - 0.80| and WITHOUT a new operational harm.
